requirement: Release tooling keeps the desktop minimum version lock: carried by prepare, re-checked by publish, changed and resumed by set-minimum

oracle.invariant: S1: a policy is three top-level lines inside the signed channel file; none writes no line (old files byte-identical); a minimum above the offered version, a dev minimum on stable, a date without timezone or without a minimum, a revision that is missing, not whole or <= 0 are refused; withPolicy refuses a lower revision (replay). S2: prepare with no flag carries the feed policy at the same revision and records policy/revision/ETag per channel file; a change without --min-version-reason, a loosening without --lower-min-version and an earlier start without a reason stop before building; publish refuses a candidate prepared before the policy was raised, lowered or the file only rewritten, and no flag (not --waive) passes; set-minimum stopped between a .yml and its .sig is refused without --resume and finished by --resume with all four files verifying under the pinned key; a replayed older policy is refused.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a policy is three top-level lines after the build id
a policy the channel file cannot carry is refused
a channel file with no policy carries no policy line
a policy older than the one a channel file carries is never written over it (replay)
prepare with no policy flag carries the feed policy over
a policy change without its reason, or a loosening without --lower-min-version, stops before building
a candidate prepared before the feed policy changed is refused at publish
set-minimum stopped between a channel file and its signature is finished by --resume
--resume never writes a policy older than one a channel file already carries (replay)
a candidate prepared before a set-minimum is refused at publish
